question: Will the Chicago White Sox win the 2026 World Series?
requirements: If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.
context: This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series.
